fieldValues.title: One fractal compass: the SRS compass is its most developed node, and its mechanism runs at every level
fieldValues.does_not_fix: It does not write the compasses for the 13 domains without affirmed axes; it makes clear which ones are needed first. It does not change the SRS compass.
fieldValues.falsifier: After a month, decisions in programme domains still reach the owner without a domain or cited axis, or the check passes decisions that the level test should have relocated.
